newsitem.title: USA: Musicland August same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Musicland August same-store sales fall.

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said Thursday that same store sales for the four weeks ended August 31 fell 4.1 percent.
Total sales for the four-week period rose two percent to $116.1 million from $113.8 million a year ago.
Musicland said sales for the superstores division, including Media Play and On Cue, increased 26.1 percent in August, and comparable store sales were up 1.3 percent.
Sales for the mall store division, including Sam Goody and Suncoast Motion Picture Co, declined 7.3 percent with same-store sales down 6.3 percent.
Musicland said its year-to-date sales increased 8.8 percent to $982.8 million compared with $903.0 million in the same period last year. Comparable-store sales year-to-date declined 1.8 percent.

"We believe the continuing weakness in our sales reflects the lack of exciting new music and movie releases," Reid Johnson, chief financial officer, said in a statement. "As we stated before, we expect the third quarter's results to be significantly below those of last year."
